summary: The long-running Accolade/Infogrames/Atari/Nacon racing series, covering the original exotic-car computer games, Off-Road branch, localized racing spin-offs, and the open-world Unlimited revival.

primary.how_to_play: Play the Amiga version through original hardware or WinUAE; use MS-DOS/Atari ST/Commodore 64 ports for comparison only.

entries.title: Test Drive Le Mans

emulation.notes: Use Dreamcast/Flycast for the primary route.

primary.version: Dreamcast Test Drive Le Mans / Le Mans 24 Hours
primary.why: Test Drive Le Mans was used for North American localizations of Le Mans 24 Hours across PlayStation, Windows, Game Boy Color, and Dreamcast. The Dreamcast version is the strongest console route in this Test Drive-localized set.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Dreamcast version on original hardware or Flycast; use PC/PlayStation/GBC only for regional-port preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a localized Le Mans 24 Hours entry, not a bespoke Test Drive design.

entries.title: Test Drive V-Rally

emulation.notes: Use Dreamcast emulation or hardware.

primary.why: Test Drive V-Rally is the North American Dreamcast localization of V-Rally 2: Expert Edition. Dreamcast is the only sourced Test Drive-branded platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Dreamcast hardware or Flycast.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a localized V-Rally 2: Expert Edition release; do not duplicate it as a separate Test Drive mainline sequel.

entries.title: Michelin Rally Masters: Race of Champions

emulation.notes: Use PC as primary; PlayStation emulation is fallback.

primary.why: The Test Drive series table includes Michelin Rally Masters because a Nintendo 64 localization titled Test Drive Rally was planned but canceled. For the released game itself, Windows is the highest-fidelity route over PlayStation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup; treat the canceled Test Drive Rally N64 localization as non-playable history.

entries.remaster_caveats: Canceled Test Drive Rally N64 version is not a playable release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Windows, PlayStation, and Dreamcast versions were canceled.

entries.title: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown

emulation.notes: No emulation route; live-service access is required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern PC output, bounded by optimization and server state

primary.why: Solar Crown released on PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows has the highest fidelity ceiling, but the game requires a constant internet connection and had last-generation versions canceled; the announced Switch version was not released by the sourced page.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release with a Nacon account and live-service access; verify current server state before buying or starting.

entries.remaster_caveats: PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions were canceled; a Nintendo Switch version was announced but not released by the cited source. Always-online access is required.
